parameters: I shouldn't leave without the others...
I shouldn't leave without the others...
We've been waiting for Luz for the whole day...
Do you think something happened to her?
I don't know what to think... but if she doesn't
make it, things will get a lot harder for us.
It's best we prepare ourselves to be on our own
from now on... we're on completely unknown territory.
Well, we have already waited the whole day, we
might as well have a good night of sleep and
figure out what to do tomorrow.
Nice of you to join us...
I'm sorry for the delay... I'm guessing there is
None... and we can't afford to wait any longer.
Luz said we were to make our way to the Fallen
Castle... I can see it from here but I can't discern
a clear path to it... yet. But if you let me focus...
I see a way to what seems to be a port...
I bet we can get clear directions to the Fallen
No doubt about that, but there is a problem...
The pathway is through a Burial Site...
Nothing comes easy around these parts...
It's what becomes of a battlefield... a wasteland
of corpses... that's not good in our side of the
world, I can't even imagine what that looks like
I imagine it as a playground of the undead...
But we have no other option... We must go.
Well, you found it... you lead.
